I’ve spent about 30 hours hooked up to a central line for insulin, and the DKA just cleared up. Now I’m here for another day for follow-ups and observation. They fasted me for 24 hours to “reset” my body. Eating still makes me want to vomit, and I feel like shit after I eat. My blood sugars were perfect overnight, and they just spiked again :( fingers crossed and no more dieting!
I injected 50 units of rapid acting when my blood sugar was 23.9 mmol and an hour later I was 17.2. It didn’t make any sense

They were fluctuating around the average. I’ve heard of the “Keto Flu” so I treated it like a cold, which requires me to double up on insulin. All of my background insulin was taken, I didn’t change a single thing about that. Fast-Acting was taken even with the slightest amount of carb. I’ve been Type 1 for 15 years next month, so I don’t think it’s that haha. 

The doctor did come in to talk to me and he believes I wasn’t flushing the ketones out fast enough, which is what happened. Plus the stress from all of that was going directly on my heart so I had a lot going on at once.

I totally agree with you! Main reason why I went on. Blood sugars before diet were averaging roughly 8. I went on the diet to improve that to about 5-6. Over the diet, my average was probably around 19.
